model.name: ModelLayer.addRepository
model.description: Opens the selector -> attach existing OR create-new via Repository/Project/GhBoundary -> mints the Repository in the M1 layer (owner-set, FQ-IOR, registered in mof-m1, live via 41.3 observer). The container owns adds to its collection (like Folder.linkIn); agents/Tron invoke this ACTION, never hand-write a Repository.
